asset: Hokkaido wooden bear salmon: v29 through v29d 2D-front-side silhouette distance-field prototype
reviewer: Direct visual inspection of actual Blender Cycles 4-angle GLB render: v28b baseline, v29, v29b, v29c, v29d; independent QA and SHA-256 from exported actual GLB
overall_artistic_result: NOT APPROVED; new SDF pipeline tech valid but visual realism not improved over v28b

independent_mesh_validation.geometry_technique: Two manually authored 2D side and front contours -> 3D SDF -> skimage marching cubes -> manifold PLY -> genuine Blender GLB -> Blender Cycles render

bear_head_and_expression.reason: v29b/d rounded head fixes boxy SDF intersection but erases meaningful eye/brow/nasal bridge and reads as a blank soft toy. v29 original worse box-like striped shape.

salmon_anatomy.reason: Tail peduncle remains a recognizable fish silhouette and fins no longer float, but gill/head features are not distinct; central fish is still a flattened paddle.

bite_legibility.reason: Upper muzzle appears resting on a horizontal fish and the lower jaw is a small underside nub; no convincing side/front C-shaped anatomical clamp.

carving_and_material.reason: These are deliberately bare form studies, not finished relief-carved wooden figures; v25 fur technique has not been reapplied.

multiview_and_reproducibility.reason: Full genuine exported GLBs, four Cycles render angles, reproducible original source scripts and CI watertight tests.

defects.finding: Bite silhouette is still anatomically incorrect after four separate SDF variants.
defects.next_fix: Use an actual side/front reference-aligned sculpture of open mouth, including underjaw, cheek and eye planes, rather than only mathematical contours.

defects.finding: v29b smooth rounded head eliminates eye sockets visually; v29c/d attempted projection onto real surface but no perceivable eye hollow in render.
defects.next_fix: Build separately bounded brow ridges, eye sockets and cheek planes in multiview sculpt; verify with close-up before smoothing/export.

defects.finding: Fish eye and gill remain subtle, and fish body resembles a broad board from front view.
defects.next_fix: Sculpt real salmon head transition, operculum, mouth and caudal tail using high-quality manually authored mesh, or licensed traceable base model.

defects.finding: A 116-vertex detached pectoral/gill strip in first v29 tests was resolved by embedding fin roots and carving gills by skin displacement, not separate cutters.
defects.next_fix: Preserve the topology QA; never silently delete substantial detached geometry.

next_recommended_step: Pivot from equation-only procedural anatomy to explicit artist-sculpted or licensed high-quality bear + salmon base mesh. Retain SDF for topology, silhouette guards and remix, not as sole high-fidelity authoring.
